messages.content: You are the President of the United States. You retain executive judgment over national policy and direct the executive departments through the established offices. The National Security Council staff prepares interagency papers; the CIA director reports covert-action planning; the Secretary of State advises on public commitments and diplomatic consequences; the Attorney General advises on legal questions. The Chief of Staff manages the decision papers and records the direction given. Do not treat an agency assessment as a presidential decision, and distinguish a proposal from an action already authorized. Use comms.send to send a message to an office or official. Use archive.fetch to retrieve a filed paper. Use intel.read to retrieve an intelligence or operations note. Use cabinet.retrieve to retrieve an executive-branch document. Use log.write to enter a decision or administrative record. Before a consequential action, the Benchbook harness may place the closest past case from its casebook in your context as reference material to weigh, not an order.

messages.name: chief-of-staff
messages.content: The overnight packet is on the desk. Keep the source labels with any extracts; the morning clerk is reconciling paper copies against the secure-room index. The west conference room has been reserved through nine, though the maintenance team is still checking its telephone line. Please pull the current cover sheet and the latest operations note before the staff begins circulating duplicates.

arguments.query: Cuba cover sheet; current planning paper; index copy

messages.name: archive.fetch
messages.content:
EXECUTIVE PACKET / shelf copy 6B / filed 06:58
Cover sheet, Cuba planning paper. The cover sheet characterizes the undertaking as massive in scale, though the staffing annex does not assign a head count. Its stated political end is to bring down the revolutionary order established in Cuba. The paper uses “limited” in the description of the method, not as a measure of the undertaking's intended political effect. The summary carries no field timetable; that page is marked for later insertion.

Clerk's margin: The blue tab belongs to the policy folder, not the operations folder. A duplicate of the map index was sent to the executive registry at 06:31. The registry copy lacks the last page of the glossary. No correction has been received from the records room. The attached press-clipping sheet is dated Monday and contains several unrelated Caribbean headlines; it was retained because the folder label matched.

messages.name: state-desk
messages.content: The State desk has returned the public-language sheet with its routing marks intact. The ambassadorial schedule in the same packet still shows the afternoon call as tentative. The translation clerk asks that any wording taken from the Spanish-language material retain the original punctuation; one copy has already lost the opening line in transit. I have not seen a replacement sheet.

messages.name: intel.read
messages.content:
OPERATIONS NOTE / revision stamp 07:36 / distribution: executive suite
Decision line: the President is the approving authority on whether the limited covert undertaking proceeds. Operational responsibility is assigned to the CIA alone. The route card describes proceeding with the limited covert undertaking while keeping the United States from publicly pledging the intended outcome. The public line remains silent on a U.S. pledge to deliver that outcome. The routing plan omits congressional engagement and does not have the government accept accountability at national level.

Assessment margin, source confidence moderate: the analysts judge that a project of this breadth would probably leave the United States with little room to deny involvement. This is an assessment, not a recorded observation of an event. The margin does not give a probability figure. The underlying note refers to the visible scale of the undertaking but does not identify which foreign audience would draw the inference first.

Routine traffic: the secure-room clock was reset after a two-minute discrepancy. The communications watch reports that the west line has passed its test call. A separate request about the afternoon courier's vehicle remains with the transport clerk. The duty copy has two staple holes where the original routing slip was removed.

messages.name: ops-lead
messages.content: The planning staff asks that the staffing annex remain attached to the cover paper; the tables are being retyped and one column heading is faint. The naval liaison has sent a routine query about map symbols, not a request for a change to the paper. I am checking that the archive copy and the working copy carry the same revision stamp.

arguments.query: Cuba framework draft; interdepartmental staffing assessment; public statement language

messages.name: cabinet.retrieve
messages.content:
EXECUTIVE POLICY FOLDER / draft framework / circulation copy
The framework describes a public statement tying the United States to the objective of ending the revolutionary government in Cuba. The draft framework pairs a public commitment to the objective with a government-wide effort drawing on departmental staff and resources. Its author leaves the details of public wording to the policy staff; the margin contains no approved text. The document is marked draft, and the registry has not logged a signed direction.

Staffing assessment attached to the draft, prepared by the interdepartmental planning group: the assessors judge that a cross-government team of experienced professionals, backed by resources from across the government, could support a different design. The note describes capacity, not a completed assignment of personnel. It does not give a proposed roster or cost estimate. The file's last page is a blank distribution sheet.

Filing note: the committee clerk used the gray folder because the green folder was needed for the budget reconciliation. The duplicate is due back at the registry before the noon inventory. A request for replacement carbon paper is clipped to the inside cover. The facilities office has asked that the room lights be switched off after the final copy is made.

messages.name: executive-secretary
messages.content: The registry is ready to receive the marked packet when convenient. The noon inventory sheet has a blank space for the return time, and the clerk has asked whether the duplicate should stay in the west room or go back to the records cabinet. The line test is complete; no further facilities notice has come in.
